verdict: When an invoice has more than about 100 line items. With Claude Sonnet 5 on 48 RealKIE invoices, single-pass scored 0.26 on the invoices with 101 to 300 line items and 0.00 on those with more than 300; agentic extraction scored 0.47 and 0.71, and cost 1.2× and 6.3× as much. At 100 line items or fewer single-pass scored higher (0.65 against 0.56 at 1 to 20 line items), and agentic cost 1.1× to 2.8× as much. Over all 48 invoices agentic cost 1.6× as much. With Claude Sonnet 5.5, on 20 invoices of up to 100 line items, both modes scored 0.62 and agentic cost 0.8× as much. Agentic extraction did not finish the invoice with 1,490 line items within Test Studio's time limit.
